card.name: Linking words before program or initiative terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (comma, of, or, a, upon) in nonprofit, public-program or government-policy text, where a word like program, initiative or policy is likely to come next.

modes.label: Lists of program types
modes.description: A comma or 'or' inside a list where the next item is likely program, initiative or intervention.
modes.example: The best time to begin to think about outcomes is when you are first planning a program<<,>> initiative, or intervention.

modes.label: Linking words in community or government text
modes.description: A small word such as 'of' or 'or' in text about community schemes or public bodies.
modes.example: It is not a one-day event<< or>> a one-visit job.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like initiatives, programs and policies, and away from customer and business words.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words just before the text is likely to say program, initiative or policy.
